COUNTING_NOTE: TOTAL_ELIGIBLE_SHOCKS counts shock bars with a complete trailing window before the 6h rule. KEPT_ELIGIBLE_SHOCKS and DEPENDENCE_CLUSTER_COUNT are the first bar in each 6h cluster. TOTAL_ALL4_EVENTS counts the all-four joint state on those kept bars. COUNT_BY_YEAR and DISTINCT_DAYS describe the kept eligible shocks, which are the nominal sample.
RETURN_DEFINITION: 15m log(close/open), known at the bar end
SHOCK_SIGMA_WINDOW_BASIS: The card names trailing sigma for the BTC shock and names trailing-30d only for the ETH sigma and the fragmentation percentile. The BTC shock sigma uses that same 30d window. It is not a searched parameter.
THINNING: first eligible shock whose end is at least 6h after the previous kept shock
THRESHOLD_WINDOW: strictly earlier bars; the event bar is not inside its own percentile or sigma
